event_summary: A small gray round object moves from the left side of the table to the right side, passing behind or partly behind a stationary white open container.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a white open rectangular container standing on a light wooden tabletop. After several moments, a small gray round object appears from the left edge, travels rightward across the tabletop, becomes partially or fully hidden by the container, then reappears on the right side and continues out of view. The container and background remain visually stationary.

reasons: The white container and tabletop are clearly visible.
The gray moving object is not yet visible in the first frame.
